subtitle: Walls of Siri, Winds of the Steppe

panels.shot: epic low-angle wide of a fortified Delhi skyline under storm-dark clouds
panels.action: Alauddin Khalji stands on the ramparts of Siri in regal armor, hand resting on his sword, stone bastions stretching behind him as distant horsemen banners dot the horizon.

dialogue.text: At the turn of the fourteenth century, Alauddin Khalji holds Delhi and his new city of Siri against the thunder of the Mongol hoof.

i18n.hi: चौदहवीं सदी की दहलीज़ पर अलाउद्दीन खिलजी, दिल्ली और अपनी नई सिरि नगरी को मंगोलों के घोड़े की गड़गड़ाहट से बचाए खड़ा है।

panels.shot: wide establishing shot of Delhi and surrounding plains
panels.action: Alauddin Khalji looks out from a palace balcony over the crowded streets of old Delhi, beyond which the flat northern plains stretch toward the unseen passes of the north-west.

dialogue.text: For decades, riders from the Chagatai steppe had tested the frontiers of Hindustan, their columns pushing toward the riches of Delhi.

i18n.hi: चग़ताई स्तेपी से आए सवार कई दशकों से हिंदुस्तान की सरहद टटोल रहे थे, उनकी टुकड़ियाँ दिल्ली की दौलत की ओर धकेलती चली आ रही थीं।

panels.shot: medium shot inside a dim audience hall
panels.action: Alauddin Khalji sits on the throne in the Delhi darbar, stern-faced, while a courtier unfurls a rough map showing routes from the Indus toward the capital.

dialogue.text: When Alauddin seized the throne in 1296, he knew Delhi’s crown meant facing not only rival nobles, but the hard steel of the Mongol frontier.

i18n.hi: १२९६ में जब अलाउद्दीन ने तख़्त पकड़ा, तो वह जानता था कि दिल्ली का ताज मतलब सिर्फ़ दुश्मन अमीर नहीं, मंगोल सरहद की तेज़ तलवार भी है।

panels.shot: wide cinematic view of a frontier encampment
panels.action: Armored horsemen with steppe-style helmets pitch tents beside the Ravi river, their scouts watching a line of distant Indian fortifications on the far bank.

dialogue.text: Between 1297 and 1306, the Chagatai launched repeated incursions—testing river crossings, raiding towns, and probing the Sultanate’s resolve.

i18n.hi: १२९७ से १३‍०६ के बीच चग़ताइयों ने बार‑बार धावे बोले—नदियाँ पार कीं, कस्बे लूटे, और सल्तनत के हौसले को परखा।

panels.shot: slow push-in on Alauddin’s face in council
panels.action: In a torchlit council chamber, Alauddin Khalji listens, jaw clenched, as generals gesture anxiously toward the north on the map spread before them.

dialogue.text: Chroniclers like Barani would later speak of vast Mongol hosts, but behind the numbers lay a ruler forced to think in stone, grain, and discipline.

i18n.hi: बरनी जैसे इतिहासकार बाद में मंगोलों की विशाल फ़ौजों का ज़िक्र करेंगे, पर उन आंकड़ों के पीछे एक ऐसा बादशाह था जो पत्थर, अन्न और अनुशासन में सोचने को मजबूर था।

panels.shot: dramatic low-angle of Alauddin rising from his throne
panels.action: Alauddin Khalji rises decisively from the throne, gesturing toward the eastern outskirts of the city where open ground waits to be claimed.

dialogue.text: Alauddin’s answer was not reckless charges but preparation: new walls, new cantonments, and the vision of a fortified suburb—Siri.

i18n.hi: अलाउद्दीन का जवाब बेपरवा धावा नहीं, तैयारी थी: नई दीवारें, नए छावनी‑इलाके और किलेबंद बस्ती का ख़याल—सिरि।

panels.action: Workers and soldiers labor under watchful officers, raising mud-brick and stone ramparts of Siri, while Alauddin Khalji surveys the work astride a horse.

dialogue.text: In the early years of his rule, he began shaping Siri as a military city—barracks, walls, and space for the army to stand between Delhi and the steppe.

i18n.hi: हुकूमत के शुरुआती सालों में उसने सिरि को फ़ौजी शहर बनाया—बारहखाने, दीवारें और ऐसा मैदान जहाँ फ़ौज दिल्ली और स्तेपी के बीच टिक सके।

panels.shot: tense interior of a palace hall
panels.action: Alauddin Khalji sits rigid on his throne as a dusty messenger kneels, reporting breathlessly about a Mongol force moving toward the region of Kili near Delhi.

dialogue.text: In 1299, word came of a Mongol force near Kili. The Sultanate would soon remember that name in grief and pride.

i18n.hi: १२९९ में ख़बर आई—किली के पास मंगोल फ़ौज दिखी है। सल्तनत जल्द ही इस नाम को दर्द और फ़ख्र संग याद करेगी।

panels.shot: dynamic wide of battle lines at Kili
panels.action: Two armies face off across dusty fields near Kili: the Mongol horsemen in loose formations, the Sultanate troops in tighter ranks beneath their standards.

dialogue.text: Alauddin’s commanders met the invaders in battle. Details blur in the chronicles, but one figure burns clearly: Zafar Khan.

i18n.hi: अलाउद्दीन के सरदारों ने दुश्मन से जंग लड़ी। तफ़सीलें इतिहास में धुंधली हैं, पर एक नाम साफ़ चमकता है—ज़फ़र ख़ान।

panels.shot: heroic low-angle on a lone commander
panels.action: Zafar Khan, in rich but battle-worn armor, spurs his horse forward ahead of his men, eyes fierce as he points his sword toward the Mongol line.

dialogue.text: Against orders, Zafar Khan pressed the attack too far. Surrounded, he fought on until he fell, remembered as a lion who did not turn back.

i18n.hi: हुक्म के ख़िलाफ़ जाकर ज़फ़र ख़ान ने हमला बहुत दूर तक खींच दिया। घिर कर भी वह लड़ता रहा, आख़िर गिर पड़ा—एक ऐसा शेर जो पलटा नहीं।

panels.action: Alauddin Khalji sits in a shadowed chamber, listening to the report of Zafar Khan’s death, his face hard, hand gripping the armrest.

dialogue.text: His death at Kili became heroic memory, yet for Alauddin it was also a lesson: courage without discipline could break the line.

i18n.hi: किली पर उसकी मौत कहानी बन गई, मगर अलाउद्दीन के लिए वह सबक भी था: बहादुरी बिना क़ायदे के मोर्चा तोड़ सकती है।

panels.shot: close-up on Alauddin’s hand marking a decree
panels.action: Alauddin Khalji signs firm orders on a scroll, as officers kneel, ready to enforce strict rules on movement and obedience among the army.

dialogue.text: In the years that followed, he tightened control over his troops, insisting on hard discipline and punishment for commanders who broke ranks unbidden.

i18n.hi: आने वाले सालों में उसने फ़ौज पर पकड़ कस दी, सख़्त अनुशासन लादा और बेइजाज़त क़तार तोड़ने वाले सरदारों को सज़ा की चेतावनी दी।

panels.shot: wide shot of Delhi skyline under threat
panels.action: From the ramparts, Alauddin Khalji and his guards watch a distant haze, as reports arrive that another Mongol host approaches in 1303.

dialogue.text: Around 1303, the danger grew greater. A Mongol force pushed so close that the heart of the Sultanate felt its breath.

i18n.hi: करीब १३‍०३ तक ख़तरा और गहरा हो चुका था। एक मंगोल लश्कर इतना पास आ गया कि सल्तनत का दिल ही उसकी साँस महसूस करने लगा।

panels.shot: dramatic bird’s-eye over Siri and old Delhi
panels.action: The fortified walls of Siri stand between Mongol encampments in the distance and the crowded lanes of old Delhi, with Alauddin Khalji visible on Siri’s bastion.

dialogue.text: That year, Siri itself was put to the test. Mongol forces besieged the new city, turning its fresh walls into the shield of Delhi.

i18n.hi: उस साल खुद सिरि की परीक्षा हुई। मंगोल फ़ौजों ने नई बस्ती को घेर लिया, उसकी ताज़ा दीवारें ही दिल्ली की ढाल बन गईं।

panels.shot: tight shot of anxious city streets
panels.action: Inside the city, citizens gather in a marketplace now half-empty, faces anxious as guards hurry past with sacks of grain toward the fortifications.

dialogue.text: Delhi did not fall, but the siege exposed a deeper wound: the city’s grain was vulnerable, prices rose, and fear ran faster than carts.

i18n.hi: दिल्ली तो बच गई, पर घेराबंदी ने भीतर की चोट दिखा दी: शहर का अनाज कमज़ोर था, आसमान छूते भाव, और डर बैलगाड़ियों से तेज़ दौड़ रहा था।

panels.shot: medium shot of Alauddin amid ledgers and officials
panels.action: Alauddin Khalji sits before piles of ledgers and grain samples while market officials stand ready, listening as he issues calm but stern economic commands.

dialogue.text: After the crisis, Alauddin moved beyond fortresses. He turned to markets and storage, laying foundations for later price and supply controls.

i18n.hi: संकट के बाद अलाउद्दीन ने सिर्फ़ क़िलों से आगे सोचा। वह बाज़ारों और भंडारों पर आया, आगे चलकर क़ीमत और रसद पर काबू की बुनियाद रख दी।

panels.action: Armies clash at a river plain near Amroha: disciplined lines of the Sultanate cavalry advance, pushing back Mongol horsemen toward the water’s edge.

dialogue.text: In 1305, at Amroha, Khalji forces fought hard and pushed the invaders back, showing that planned resistance could blunt steppe raids.

i18n.hi: १३‍०५ में अमरोहा पर खिलजी फ़ौज ने जान लगा कर जंग लड़ी और दुश्मन को पीछे धकेला, दिखा दिया कि सोच‑समझ कर की गई मज़ाहमत स्तेपी के धावों को कुंद कर सकती है।

panels.shot: wide shot of fighting near the Ravi river
panels.action: On the banks of the Ravi, dense formations of Delhi troops hold a line as Mongol cavalry wheel and probe, unable to break through the prepared defense.

dialogue.text: The next year, near the Ravi frontier, they stood again. Frontier forts, prepared fields, and firm command limited the Mongols’ reach.

i18n.hi: अगले साल रावी सरहद के पास वे फिर खड़े थे। सरहद‑किले, तैयार खेत और मज़बूत फ़रमान ने मंगोलों की पहुँच को चंद क़दमों में सिमटा दिया।

panels.shot: poetic medium shot of Alauddin at twilight
panels.action: At twilight on Siri’s walls, Alauddin Khalji leans on the parapet, watching smoke from distant encampments fade as the city behind him glows with lamplight.

dialogue.text: The Mongol danger did not vanish, yet in Alauddin’s years the capital held. Siri’s walls, and his harsh order, taught Delhi that preparation outlasts panic.

i18n.hi: मंगोल ख़तरा मिटा नहीं, लेकिन अलाउद्दीन के ज़माने में राजधानी टिकी रही। सिरि की दीवारों और उसकी सख़्त नीयत ने दिल्ली को सिखाया—तैयारी, दहशत से ज़्यादा टिकती है।

title_i18n.en: Alauddin Holds Siri Against the Mongols
title_i18n.hi: मंगोलों के सामने सिरि की ढाल: अलाउद्दीन

subtitle_i18n.en: Walls of Siri, Winds of the Steppe
subtitle_i18n.hi: सिरि की दीवारें, स्तेपी की आँधियाँ
